title: ReelSaid — Instagram Reels Transcript API
description: Transcribe Instagram Reels to text in bulk with Whisper Large-v3. Get original-language transcripts, word timestamps, three-second hooks, SRT, WebVTT, and post metadata from public Reel links, profiles, or datasets.
seoDescription: Transcribe Instagram Reels and profiles with Whisper Large-v3. Get timed transcripts, word timestamps, SRT, WebVTT, opening hooks, and post metadata.
